packet.title: Compiling large stylesheets (implementation)
packet.summary: Makes compiling large stylesheets linear in the unit's size: the descendant-path and global-read passes and the lowerer's declaration check, with the IR text form unchanged.

body.p: After , and . Validating one EN 16931 invoice with the official pre-compiled stylesheet (900 KB of XSLT, from ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931) costs 2.68 x 10^9 instructions, about 0.5 s, and 79 % of it is compiling the stylesheet: reading 41 % (tree-sitter's XML parse 23 %), XPath parsing 25 %, IR passes 32 %; the validation itself 20 %. Two passes dominate on their own: sxml_ir_shorten_descendant_paths 12.5 % (self) and sxml_ir_read_globals_lazily 8.6 % (self), which suggests work that grows with the square of the unit (each template or global revisits the whole unit). Every sxml transform and, after , every Schematron compile pays this.

item.p: Mechanism: profile first (callgrind on the invoice run above and on a stylesheet of growing size made by repeating templates, to show the growth); make each pass linear (or n log n) in the unit's size with the same result; then the next largest compile cost the profile shows in the files below. The IR after the passes must be the same: compare the IR text form (src/ir.c's printer) before and after on the EN 16931 stylesheet and the XT40 suite's stylesheets.

Owns: src/ir_loop_passes.c, src/ir_global_read.c, src/ir.c (the pass list and helpers), src/ir_internal.h and src/ir_pass_internal.h (their pass parts), src/xpath_parse.c, src/xpath_lower.c, tests/ir_loop_passes_test.c, tests/bench/. Not src/xslt*.c (7.28).

Done when: each change measured before and after (instructions and seconds) in a D-record and the commit messages, on the invoice run, a growth series showing linear passes, xmark-all and SchXslt's expand stage; the IR text form identical; QT4 XP40, XQ40 and XT40 whole, base and change built and run in the same setup: no outcome changes, case by case. Done 2026-10-28 (): descendant and global-read passes and the lowerer's declaration check linear; fusion skips functions without a QUANTIFIED; AST kinds kept per grammar symbol. Invoice 2.680 to 2.076 x 10^9 instructions; growth N = 128 57.1 to 6.2; IR text identical; XP40, XQ40, XT40 0 outcomes differ.
